name: Essential amino acids + Ketoanalogues
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Chronic kidney failure, GFR 25 mL/min/1.73 m2 or less, with protein intake 40 g/day or less (adults)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 4 to 8 tablets three times daily with meals (70 kg adult); swallow whole

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Tetracyclines, quinolones (ciprofloxacin, norfloxacin), iron, fluoride, estramustine
key_interactions.effect: Calcium forms poorly soluble complexes and lowers their absorption.
key_interactions.action: Separate doses by at least 2 hours.

key_interactions.effect: Phosphate may fall as uremic symptoms improve.
key_interactions.action: Reduce aluminum hydroxide if needed; monitor phosphate.

contraindications: Inborn errors of amino acid metabolism
monitoring: Only with a dietitian-supervised low-protein diet; nutritional status (weight, albumin, intake); calcium with calcium binders or active vitamin D

pk.peak: Keto-acid levels peak 20 to 60 minutes after an oral dose (healthy subjects)
pk.metabolism: Rapid transamination to the corresponding essential amino acids

sources.citation: Fresenius Kabi España, S.A.U. (2020). Ketosteril comprimidos recubiertos con película [Ficha técnica (summary of product characteristics); text revised December 2020]. Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS), CIMA registration 85837.

D., Teta, D., Yee-Moon Wang, A., & Cuppari, L. (2020). KDOQI clinical practice guideline for nutrition in CKD: 2020 update. American Journal of Kidney Diseases, 76(3 Suppl 1), S1–S107.

draft_notes: Most PH PIs are for Ketosteril (Fresenius Kabi) and look-alike generics; tablet composition assumed identical.

revision_log.change: Monitoring: adjunct to supervised low/very-low-protein diet only (KDOQI 2020); nutritional status; additive hypercalcemia with calcium binders/active vitamin D.
